parameters.content:
### Steps 6–11 · one try
One try of the recipe: calls `Steps 6–9 · choose ingredients` (the one model call; `choose.feedback` carries the failures of the last try), logs rows 6 to 9, calls `Steps 10–11 · compute and validate`, and logs rows 10 and 11 with this try's number. Row 11 is ok when step 11 passed, else it holds the failure lines as its error. Returns `{passed, try, step10, step11, next_feedback}`; `next_feedback` is the next try's `choose.feedback` (the lines, every pick banned so far and the failed recipe's picks), null when the recipe passed or this was try 3. A failure in steps 6–9 or in step 10 logs its row and stops with its message.

### Test data · editor run
Pin this on `When Executed by Another Workflow` (open the node, use the output panel's edit / mock-data control, paste the JSON, save), then click *Execute workflow*.
Calls the model and writes the log rows of try 1 for the run in `run_id`: set it to the id of an existing `app.run` (the rows cascade-delete with the run); `0` belongs to no run, so the first log row fails on its foreign key.
